$comment: Single source of truth for Buildd's externally-triggered cron jobs. These are NOT Vercel crons — vercel.json's `crons` array covers a different, smaller set, and the two lists must not overlap. An external scheduler (cron-job.org) calls these with `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET`. Run `bun run cron:plan` to preview, `bun run cron:sync` to apply, `bun run cron:check` as a CI gate. Schedules are 5-field cron expressions evaluated in `timezone`. Reconciliation is origin-scoped: only jobs under CRON_TARGET_BASE_URL + /api/cron/ are ever touched, so unrelated projects sharing the scheduler account are safe. See docs/cron-jobs.md.

jobs.$comment: Mission/task schedule tick. Must run every 30 min, all 24 hours: task_schedules rows use */30 cron expressions, and isOverdue() allows only interval*2 before flagging a schedule late. Previously hand-configured in the provider console as `0 7-19 * * *`, which silently starved every schedule for 12 hours a night.
jobs.title: Buildd: Schedules Tick

jobs.$comment: BT-11/BT-19 stall notification. Route comment recommends every 5 minutes. Staged dark — no trigger has ever existed for this route.
jobs.title: Buildd: Stall Notify

jobs.$comment: Distills feedback down-votes/dismissals into memories. Route comment recommends every 1-4 hours. Staged dark — no trigger has ever existed for this route.

jobs.$comment: Weekly signing-key rotation (cross-app-assertion-grant spec B.3). Rotates when the Active key is older than 30d, so a weekly tick is sufficient. Staged dark — no trigger has ever existed, meaning signing keys have never rotated.
jobs.title: Buildd: JWKS Rotation
